title: English Indices of Deprivation (IoD25)
text: Indices Deprivation 2025 (IoD25) measure relative deprivation across small geographic areas England. IoD25 formed 7 domains measure different aspects deprivation, one combined Index Multiple Deprivation (IMD) 2 supplementary indices. iod25 package made 3 core datasets: domains contains 7 domain measures imd contains Index Multiple Deprivation supplementary contains 2 supplementary indices two additional datasets: subdomains contains underlying measures used construct domains population contains population denominators used construct indices
